in_marathi.name: Alaka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Alaka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Alaka refers to the one who resides near a river or lake. In Hindu mythology, Alaka is a name of various goddesses, including a river goddess and the goddess of prosperity. It is a name full of tranquility and abundance.
